data.description:
## testing_mode: RED

## Task

Add RED-phase tests to `tests/scripts/test-ci-findings-normalize.sh` for the Tier 2, 3, and 4 normalizer functions and the log-fetch helper. These tests must fail (RED) before implementation.

## Tests to add

### _normalize_tier2 (test failures)
- `t_normalize_tier2_output_schema`: Given a fixture file with pytest/jest test failure text, When _normalize_tier2 is called, Then output JSON has schema_version=1, tier='test', findings array
- `t_normalize_tier2_schema_conformance`: Each findings entry has severity, description, file fields
- `t_normalize_tier2_missing_input_exits_3`: When called with empty string input, exits 3 (ARTIFACT_MISSING)
- `t_normalize_tier2_log_parses_pytest_output`: Given fixture file with pytest failure text (FAILED tests/foo.py::test_bar - AssertionError), When _normalize_tier2 called, Then findings contain the test name

### _normalize_tier3 (lint failures)
- `t_normalize_tier3_output_schema`: Given ruff/eslint output fixture, Then schema_version=1, tier='lint', findings array
- `t_normalize_tier3_schema_conformance`: findings entries have severity/description/file
- `t_normalize_tier3_missing_input_exits_3`: empty input → exit 3

### _normalize_tier4 (other/unknown)
- `t_normalize_tier4_output_schema`: Given any text log, Then schema_version=1, tier='other', findings array
- `t_normalize_tier4_missing_input_exits_3`: empty input → exit 3

### _fetch_ci_log helper
- `t_fetch_ci_log_calls_gh_run_view`: When run_id is given, _fetch_ci_log invokes gh with 'run view --log-failed'; stub gh as a bash function in the subshell

## Implementation notes
- Source the lib with CI_FINDINGS_LIB_MODE=1 in each test subshell
- Use mktemp for all temp files; clean up with trap RETURN
- Fixture files: inline heredoc strings in each test (no separate fixture files)
- RED marker: add '[t_normalize_tier2_output_schema]' to the .test-index entry for ci-findings-normalize.sh pointing at test-ci-findings-normalize.sh

## Files to modify
- tests/scripts/test-ci-findings-normalize.sh
- .test-index (add RED marker)
